description.en: Visual spring generator and easing curve designer for modern CSS animations.
description.zh: 专为现代 CSS 动画量身打造的可视化弹簧物理模拟器与缓动曲线生成器。

content.en: Easing Wizard is a browser-based tool for visualising, fine-tuning, and generating linear() easing springs for CSS. By approximating real-world physics into pure CSS timing functions, it allows web developers to achieve bouncy, fluid animations without any runtime JavaScript.
content.zh: Easing Wizard 是一款用于实时调试与生成纯 CSS linear() 弹簧物理缓动曲线的可视化神器。它通过数学插值将真实的质量块阻尼物理运动转化为现代 CSS 原生支持的时序关键点，让纯 CSS 动画也能具备令人赞叹的物理回弹质感，彻底省去 JS 运行时开销。
